string.text: Star Iron
Temporary Covenant Sword
Journeyman's Seal
Heart's Fire
Legendary Covenant Sword
Apprentice's Oath
{EfsaneviDemirci.Name} summons you to forge your clan's legendary sword. However, you need to find 5 Star Iron around {HammadeKaynagi_Link} for the sword.
Hired Assassins
While gathering ores, bandits hired by the Rival Merchant ambushed you! You must defeat them.
You have cleared the ambushers. You can now return to your quest.
You convinced the blacksmith and received a pre-forged sword as a shortcut.
You collected the Star Iron, you can now deliver them to {EfsaneviDemirci.Name}.
The name of your clan is growing, child. I forged the sword of your ancestors; now it's time I forge a new one for you. But first, bring me 5 Star Iron.
Where can I find this ore?
I don't have time to wait this long, just give me an already forged sword.
My eyes aren't deceiving me, are they? You brought the Star Iron!
Yes master, here you go.
This is it! Now to the fire — the sword is starting to take shape. Take this sword for now, we will meet again when your name is heard even further.
Thank you master. I will be waiting.
Journeyman's Trial
{EfsaneviDemirci.Name} received word that night raids are planned on his workshop. He wants to speak with you about an important matter.
You decided to stay in the village and stand guard against the ambush for 5 days. Be careful, the attack could come at any moment.
Rival Workshop Saboteurs
The expected saboteurs attacked the village! You must defeat them to protect the workshop.
Instead of waiting on the defense, you decided to solve the problem at its source. You must confront {RakipTuccar.Name}.
{RakipTuccar.Name} did not submit to your threats and unleashed his guards on you. Defeat them to survive.
You successfully resolved the issue and the Legendary Blacksmith honored you as a Journeyman!
Child, I've learned that night raids are planned on our workshop. The merchant {RakipTuccar.Name} is behind this. If we can't protect the workshop, we can't move to the final stages of the sword.
I will stay in the village and keep guard, they won't be able to step foot here.
I'll solve the problem at its source. I will find the merchant and teach him a lesson.
Trade in these lands is my right, not that old blacksmith's! What do you want?
I offer you 2000 gold. Let this go.
If you don't pull your men from the workshop, I'll visit you in your sleep tonight. [Roguery]
O-okay, calm down! I'm done with that geezer's workshop, leave me alone.
Who are you threatening, punk? Guards, kill this fool!
Merchant Guards
Forging the Legacy
There's only one step left to complete the legendary sword. {EfsaneviDemirci.Name} expects you at his workshop.
To finalize the sword's spirit, you need to deliver the 'Heart's Fire', which costs 50,000 gold.
The Covenant Sword is finally forged! Talk to the Legendary Blacksmith to decide who the sword will belong to.
The Covenant Sword became your clan's eternal legacy. The power and glory of your clan spread across the whole realm!
You gifted the Covenant Sword to your king. Your influence and reputation within the kingdom reached legendary proportions!
Child, my brother {Kalan.Name} and I have been working for months. The steel is perfected. But to give it a soul we need the 'Heart's Fire', which costs 50,000 gold.
I will gather the necessary gold and resources and return.
Did you bring what's needed for the ritual fire?
Here is 50,000 gold. Finish the sword.
I haven't gathered enough resources yet.
The fire burns! Give me a few hours... (Anvil sounds rise and the sword is completed with a legendary glow) Our masterpiece is ready! There is one last thing we need to discuss.
The Covenant Sword... The most perfect steel I have forged to this day. Will you wield this power as your own clan's eternal legacy, or will you gift it to the king you serve?
This sword will be the symbol of the unshakable power of my lineage and my clan.
I will present this unique sword to King {IttifakKrali.Name}. The glory of our kingdom will increase.
Master's Burden
The Legendary Blacksmith hurriedly calls you to his side. He seems to have received very bad news.
The blacksmith's brother {Kalan.Name} has fallen prisoner. You need to rescue him from {DusmanKale_Link} or wherever he is. You can sneak in, besiege the castle, or pay his ransom.
Your infiltration attempt was noticed! Patrols swarmed you. If you defeat them, you can take Kalan and escape.
You rescued Kalan! Now the final preparations for the legendary sword can be made.
Child... My brother {Kalan.Name} has fallen prisoner. I cannot finish the sword without him. I beg you, rescue him!
I will find your brother and bring him back safe and sound. Do not worry.
Who are you? Did my older brother send you? Thank goodness... But this place is heavily guarded, how will we get out?
Be quiet and follow me. I've memorized the patrols' routes. [Roguery]
Let's go immediately!
Careful, there are guards behind you! They noticed us!
Garrison Guards
